findings.reason: an implementing node would either silently drop the after interleaving or weaken the assertion, and the measure it is closed on would not be the one the section states; the author needs to scope the committed-file clause to the before and during orderings.
findings.text: "In every case the state write's change is in the checkout's plan file and in the committed file once the landing has finished" cannot hold for the third ordering the same sentence names, a state write made after the landing: once the landing has finished its commit exists, so a write made afterwards is in the checkout's working tree and in no commit, and the sentence's only alternative ("or the state write answered as not landed and named why") is false for a write that did land — so the after case is unsatisfiable as written

findings.reason: the measure cannot distinguish a fix that keeps both changes from one that simply refuses contention, so the node would be closed on an assertion a degenerate fix satisfies; one clause requiring the uncontended write to land (and, for contention, that refusal is what the endpoint's second sentence permits) is what separates them.
findings.text: the done-when's escape branch ("or the state write answered as not landed and named why") is available in every one of the six kinds and three orderings, so a fix that refuses every state write while a landing is in flight passes the gate while preserving nothing, which is the workaround-adding outcome the plan exists to remove
